name: Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Verdicchio can be almost colorless, with a slight green-yellow hue.
It has noticeably high acidity with citrus notes.
Sparkling and sweet passito versions are also made.

blurb.text: A white wine from the Marche, made around Cupramontana, Montecarotto and Arcevia, as still or quality sparkling wine. Its wine is named for the Verdicchio grape.
